_comment: Per-run knobs, most-edited first. Account infra lives in pipeline/pipeline_config.json (CDK-generated); per-robot semantics in pipeline/configs/*.yaml. CLI flags override anything here. The two blocks NOT to edit per run are 'solution' and 'image' (see their own comments). project_config.openarms.json is a second worked example — a 16-dim bimanual arm on ml.g7e.48xlarge — usable with --project-config, and project_config.openarms.mix.json is a third: the same arm trained on a pooled real+sim corpus, which needs a PRE-PREPPED dataset (its embodiment config sets format: gear so the pipeline does not recompute normalisation stats). Neither ships the dataset itself; read the dataset._comment in each before using it.

dataset._comment: revision v2.1 = the LeRobot-v2.1-format branch of the HF repo (main may be v3-format). Local data goes in the repo's dataset/ folder (gitignored): set source=local and local_path=dataset/<your_dataset>. HF downloads land in <cache_dir>/<run name>/; relative paths resolve against the repo root. See dataset/README.md.

training._comment: The shipped defaults are the demo run the Costs table in README.md measures: 1000 steps on ml.g7e.24xlarge, ~4h11m, ~$93. Cost is linear in max_steps, so raising it raises the bill proportionally — measure seconds/step at the smoke gate and project the full run before the train stage (pass --stop-after smoke; the default stage range runs through train and merge with no prompt).
training._comment_loader_ram: The sharded loader decodes a whole shard of video into host RAM per dataloader worker (~rows x cameras x HxWx3 bytes, roughly double while the next shard prefetches). At the trainer defaults (8 workers/GPU, 10k-row shards) the ALOHA demo needs ~880GB on a 4-GPU instance and the job dies with 'DataLoader worker exited unexpectedly' + a SageMaker 'use an instance type with more memory' ClientError. 4 workers x 2.5k-row shards keeps it near ~220GB peak.
training._comment_horizon: Pick the horizon before launching. Resuming a finished run at a higher max_steps is a warm restart, not 'training longer': scheduler.pt restores only position, not the curve, so the LR jumps back to a large fraction of peak in one step with no warmup. Treat any extension as a deliberate second phase at reduced LR.

compute._comment: Per-stage instance settings. volume_gb is inert on instance types with NVMe instance store (g7e gets its full instance store regardless); it only binds on EBS-only types, where 119GiB of input channels plus (save_total_limit + 1) x ~89GiB of checkpoints needs >=900. Runtime caps are not billed; only actual usage is.

image._comment: ECR tag the deploy-time image build pushes. Read from THIS file only (cdk/app.py resolves it and ignores --project-config) — see cdk/README.md.

solution._comment: AWS Solution identity — the single source of truth for both reporting mechanisms: the CloudFormation stack Description (deployment counting) and the AWS SDK User-Agent suffix (API usage attribution). Not a per-run knob: bump 'version' when cutting a release and otherwise leave it alone. pipeline/solution.py is the only reader and always reads THIS file, not the --project-config override, so a per-run config cannot strip the identity. See pipeline/solution.py for the exact formats.
solution.name: DreamZero Finetuning on Amazon SageMaker
